stream.stream_c1_note: the c=1 streaming legs read 64 frame(s) through the gateway and 64 direct to the mock, out of a 64 frame budget; the added-gap figures are medians over the intervals between those frames, and the p99 fields are absent because one stream cannot support a 99th percentile

memory.protocol: cold restart, idle read at rest, then load at c=32 in repeated windows until the              trailing 60s is flat (cap 300s), then 60s with the load removed

stream.added_gap_p99_us.detail: the gateway's own inter-frame gap at this percentile (21130us) came in under the mock's (21149us), which a proxy cannot really do - the added gap here is below what this rig can resolve against the mock's 20ms pacing
